tools.name: modal_app_list
tools.description: List deployed/running Modal apps (``modal app list``).

tools.name: modal_app_stop
tools.description: Stop a running Modal app by id or name (``modal app stop``).

tools.name: modal_run
tools.description:
Run a Modal entrypoint, e.g. ``app.py::main`` (``modal run``).

May start billable compute. Set ``detach=True`` to return without streaming.

tools.name: modal_deploy
tools.description: Deploy a Modal app from a file/ref (``modal deploy``).

tools.name: modal_volume_ls
tools.description: List Modal volumes, or files inside one volume (``modal volume list|ls``).

tools.name: modal_secret_list
tools.description: List Modal secret names (``modal secret list``).

tools.name: modal_app_logs
tools.description:
Fetch a bounded window of an App's streaming logs (``modal app logs``).

``modal app logs`` follows the stream; this captures up to ``timeout`` s then
returns the window (``truncated`` if the stream was still open).

tools.name: modal_container_list
tools.description: List currently-running Modal containers (``modal container list``).

tools.name: modal_container_exec
tools.description:
Execute a command in a running container (``modal container exec``).

``command`` is split shell-style (``shlex``) into argv for the container.

tools.name: modal_container_logs
tools.description: Fetch a bounded window of a container's logs (``modal container logs``).

tools.name: modal_container_stop
tools.description:
Terminate a running container (``modal container stop``). Gated.

Destructive: gated behind ``confirm``/``dry_run``.

tools.name: modal_volume_create
tools.description: Create a named, persistent Modal Volume (``modal volume create``).

tools.name: modal_volume_put
tools.description: Upload a local file/dir into a Volume (``modal volume put``).

tools.name: modal_volume_get
tools.description: Download a path from a Volume to local (``modal volume get``).

tools.name: modal_volume_rm
tools.description:
Delete a file/dir INSIDE a Volume (``modal volume rm``). Gated.

Destructive: gated behind ``confirm``/``dry_run``.

tools.name: modal_volume_delete
tools.description:
Delete an ENTIRE named Volume and all its data (``modal volume delete``).

Destructive: gated behind ``confirm``/``dry_run``.

tools.name: modal_secret_create
tools.description:
Create/overwrite a named Modal Secret from ``entries`` (``modal secret create``).

Prefer ``${ENV}``-sourced values. NOTE: values are passed as CLI argv, so on
a shared host they may be briefly visible in the process list; ``force`` (=
``--force``) overwrites an existing secret of the same name.

tools.name: modal_whoami
tools.description: Show the Modal identity/workspace in use (``modal token info``).

tools.name: modal_estimate_cost
tools.description:
Estimate Modal compute cost from GPU/CPU/memory-seconds (LOCAL calc).

``gpu`` is a type (e.g. ``"a100"``, ``"h100"``, ``"t4"``) optionally with a
count (``"a100:2"``). ``tier`` is ``"sandbox"`` (Sandboxes/Notebooks) or
``"standard"`` (Functions) -- CPU/memory bill higher on the sandbox tier.
Modal exposes NO public billing API, so this is an estimate from list price.

tools.name: modal_cloud_bucket_mount_config
tools.description:
Build a CloudBucketMount config entry (LOCAL; no API call).

Pass the returned object inside ``cloud_bucket_mounts=[...]`` of
``modal_sandbox_create`` to mount an S3/GCS/R2 bucket. ``secret`` names a
Modal Secret holding the bucket credentials; ``bucket_endpoint_url`` targets
GCS/R2/MinIO. ``key_prefix`` (if set) must end with ``/``.

tools.name: modal_sandbox_create
tools.description:
Create a Modal Sandbox (a live container) and return its ``sandbox_id``.

``image`` is a registry tag (default ``debian_slim``); ``command`` runs an
entrypoint (omit for an idle box you ``exec`` into until ``timeout``).
``volumes`` maps ``mount_path -> volume_name`` (created if missing);
``cloud_bucket_mounts`` takes entries from ``modal_cloud_bucket_mount_config``
to mount an S3/GCS/R2 bucket. **A ``gpu`` (e.g. ``"a100"``, ``"h100"``,
``"t4"``, ``"a100:2"``) is BILLABLE per second** until terminated.
``account`` selects a per-call credential profile.

tools.name: modal_sandbox_exec
tools.description:
Run a shell ``command`` (via ``sh -c``) inside a sandbox; capture output.

Returns ``{returncode, stdout, stderr}``. Use ``modal_sandbox_exec_stream``
for line-buffered output of a long command.

tools.name: modal_sandbox_exec_stream
tools.description:
Run ``command`` and collect up to ``max_lines`` of streamed stdout lines.

True token-streaming is impossible over a single MCP request/response; this
reads the process's stdout stream line-by-line and returns the collected
window plus the exit code (``truncated`` if ``max_lines`` was hit).

tools.name: modal_sandbox_write_file
tools.description: Write UTF-8 text ``content`` to ``path`` inside the sandbox filesystem.

tools.name: modal_sandbox_read_file
tools.description: Read ``path`` from the sandbox (UTF-8 text, or base64 when ``binary``).

tools.name: modal_sandbox_upload
tools.description: Upload a LOCAL file to ``remote_path`` inside the sandbox.

tools.name: modal_sandbox_download
tools.description: Download ``remote_path`` from the sandbox to a LOCAL file.

tools.name: modal_sandbox_ls
tools.description: List directory entries at ``path`` inside the sandbox.

tools.name: modal_sandbox_mkdir
tools.description: Create directory ``path`` inside the sandbox (``parents`` = ``mkdir -p``).

tools.name: modal_sandbox_rm
tools.description: Remove ``path`` inside the sandbox (``recursive`` for a directory tree).

tools.name: modal_sandbox_stat
tools.description: Stat ``path`` inside the sandbox (runs ``stat`` -- needs coreutils).

tools.name: modal_sandbox_list
tools.description:
List running sandboxes, optionally filtered by ``app_name`` / ``tags``.

(``sandbox_id`` is accepted but ignored -- listing is by app/tags; use
``modal_sandbox_from_id`` to inspect one sandbox.)

tools.name: modal_sandbox_from_id
tools.description: Reattach to a sandbox by id and report its liveness + tags.

tools.name: modal_sandbox_poll
tools.description: Poll a sandbox: returncode if exited, else ``running`` (non-blocking).

tools.name: modal_sandbox_wait
tools.description: Block until the sandbox's entrypoint exits, then return its returncode.

tools.name: modal_sandbox_terminate
tools.description: Terminate a sandbox (stops billing). Gated behind ``confirm``/``dry_run``.

tools.name: modal_sandbox_tags
tools.description:
Get the sandbox's tags, or SET them when ``tags`` is provided.

Tags let a stateless server find sandboxes later (``modal_sandbox_list``).

tools.name: modal_sandbox_snapshot
tools.description:
Snapshot the sandbox filesystem to a reusable Image; return its image id.

Use to bake a post-install image (e.g. after a Schrodinger Suite install) so
later sandboxes skip the install: pass the id as ``image`` to a create call.

tools.name: modal_function_call
tools.description:
Call a deployed Modal Function synchronously (``.remote``) and return it.

**May start billable (GPU) compute.** Use ``modal_function_spawn`` +
``modal_functioncall_get`` for long jobs you do not want to block on.

tools.name: modal_function_spawn
tools.description:
Spawn a deployed Function async (``.spawn``); return a function_call_id.

Poll/collect the result later with ``modal_functioncall_get``. **May start
billable compute.**

tools.name: modal_functioncall_get
tools.description: Fetch a spawned call's result by id (``timeout=0`` blocks until ready).
